# How many employees does Sauce Labs have?

Sauce Labs, Inc. has approximately329 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Sauce Labs’s total headcount has grown7.4% from 306 employees in 2023 to 329 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Sauce Labs hiring right now?

Yes, Sauce Labs isactively hiring. Sauce Labs had30 active job postings in 2026, a 79.1% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/sauce-labs/employees#postings).

## About Sauce Labs’s Workforce

Sauce Labs, Inc. is an Information Technology Services company based in San Francisco, California, founded in 2008. It employs **329** people worldwide as of June 2026 and ranks as the 7th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/sauce-labs/employees#similar-companies).

Sauce Labs's workforce has grown **7.4%** from 2023 to 2026, and it is up **1.6%** year over year in 2026. The company’s headcount fell to a low of **265** in 2025 Q1 before recovering. Its geographic distribution is led by North America at **47.8%**, followed by South Asia at **17.5%** and Western Europe at **16.3%**.

Sauce Labs's groups are Engineering ( **45.5%**), Finance and Operations ( **32.1%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **22.4%**), with Sales and Marketing growing the fastest at **21.5%**. The global average salary is **$134,394,** with a median of **$170,000** in Northern Europe and **$32,000** in South Asia, and the overall compensation declined **13.6%** year over year in 2026.

Sauce Labs's hiring activity shows momentum, with active postings increasing **79.1%** to **30** in 2026 Q2. New postings per month rose from **18** in 2023 to **26** in 2026, reflecting a strengthening hiring pace, while overall employee sentiment remains negative and trending downward.
